title: Double Drip Pineapple Ice 100ml Shortfill
description: One vape from Double Drip’s Pineapple Ice is enough to whisk you away to exotic, sun-soaked shores, riding a tsunami of fabulously fruity flavour. A tropical treat with that luscious, tantalising tang you only get with fresh Pineapple, this irresistibly authentic e-liquid will soak your tastebuds in a tidal wave of flavour before a jolt of icy menthol kicks in, lifting the experience to giddy new heights. Sweet, sharp, juicy and endlessly refreshing, Pineapple Ice brings a blissful blast of Caribbean sunshine with every puff. Long-lasting 100ml Shortfill bottles from Double Drip offer the ideal way to personalize your favourite e-liquid flavours by adding nicotine to your exact preference. Each bottle comes with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an additional 20ml of space for two nicotine shots , giving you complete control over your vaping experience. To create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots to a 100ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and voila, you have your perfect mix. Alternatively, leave out the nicotine entirely and simply enjoy the pure, delicious flavour and rich, billowing sub-ohm clouds. Shortfills not only offer extended longevity from your favourite e-liquid flavours but also serve as more economical and convenient alternative to smaller bottles of high-vg e-liquid. Thanks to their higher VG content, they're the perfect match for high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits and low-resistance coils , ensuring maximum flavour and vapour production from your device. Discover the ultimate vaping experience with Double Drip E-Liquid, a hugely popular and influential vape juice brand proudly made in the UK. With a wide range of e-liquid formulations to suit all e-cigarette setups, Double Drip has an e-juice for every preference. Whether you prefer sub-ohm (high-VG) e-liquid , 50/50 e-liquid , Nicotine Salts , or long-lasting shortfills, Double Drip has you covered. Please note: This shortfill contains a high concentrate of flavour when compared to 50ml Double Drip shortfills
